messages:
Rowan (CSE): FYI NimbusHealth just enabled an organization-wide analytics assistant for Clinical Insights (3 teams). They're seeing steady multi-turn sessions + a large nightly batch of patient-summary generation. Customers asking about per-team spend, a way to isolate noisy teams, and a path to committed capacity before renewal (~40 days). cc @Becky @Maya

Becky (CS Ops): Can you share qps and typical token sizes? Is the nightly job async?

Rowan (CSE): Live traffic during day; nightly job is async: ~500k summaries over 8h. Day traffic: Team A (ClinOps) ~70 seats, avg prompt 1.5k tokens, replies ~600 tokens, peak ~3 reqs/sec/seat. Team B (Research) ~25 seats, longer contexts ~2.4k tokens. Combined tenant qps ~560 with bursts to ~1.1k. They hit transient 429s last night during backfill.

Ethan (Eng-runtime): Likely KV eviction + batching pressure from the large async run. Short-term mitigations: 1) throttle backfill concurrency, 2) route backfill to a dedicated ingest lane, 3) add per-team concurrency caps to contain noisy teams. For predictable SLA, recommend Dedicated.

Maya (AE): I'll offer a 14-day committed-capacity pilot focused on keeping Clinical Insights latency <300ms p95. Need an estimate of GPU-hours and expected cost delta to present to their finance team. Renewal is sensitive to billing surprises.

Jonah (Product): Product asks logged: per-team spend dashboard, per-team quotas in console, and message-level team tag in audit logs. Also request for a bulk-ingest estimator in the console. Please capture exact fields they need for audit logs.

Rowan (CSE): Sanity payload sample (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-xlarge-2026",
  "messages": ["system: summarize patient notes","user: long transcript ~2k tokens"],
  "max_tokens": 1200
}
```
They also requested a forecast widget showing "nightly backfill cost" vs "steady-state monthly cost".

Ethan (Eng-runtime): I'll open INF-9450 to add a backfill routing option and per-team concurrency caps. Quick canary config for pilot:
```yaml
tenant: nimbushealth-clinical
backfill_route: dedicated-ingest-1
kv_retention: extended
team_concurrency: {ClinOps: 6, Research: 4}
pinned_pool: committed-pilot-4x
```

Becky (CS Ops): OPS-8033 opened to provision `committed-pilot-4x` (requesting 4 GPUs for 14 days). ETA provisioning ~24h.

Maya (AE): I'll prepare pricing scenarios: A) seat-tier + burst credits, B) committed pool with amortized GPU-hours and per-team caps. If pilot reduces tail errors by >40% and cost delta <35%, push to convert.

infra-bot: Committed pilot pool `committed-pilot-4x` allocated to tenant nimbushealth-clinical (expires in 14 days).

Rowan (CSE): Plan: 1) Ethan -> INF-9450 + apply canary once pool ready, 2) Becky -> OPS-8033 follow-up on quotas, 3) Maya -> renewal scenarios and finance brief, 4) Jonah -> collect exact audit log fields and dashboard requirements. I'll run the enablement session with their ops team tomorrow. Renewal risk: medium-high until pilot validates predictable billing. I'll post metrics (p50/p95/p99, 429s, cost delta) here during pilot. :spiral_calendar:
